mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ticket (id, customer_id, content, intent, status, response, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{customerId}, #{content}, #{intent}, #{status}, #{response}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, customer_id, content, intent, status, response, created_at, updated_at FROM ticket WHERE status = #{status} ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ticket_ai_record (id, ticket_id, model, prompt, response, intent, latency_ms, success, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{ticketId}, #{model}, #{prompt}, #{response}, #{intent}, #{latencyMs}, #{success}, #{createdAt})
